Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.35.0 adds Gungnir V5.2's nine-second dark-teal and old-gold sky judgment, four-stage giant-spear presentation, explicit coexistence with Mjolnir storms, borderless skill icons and reliable authenticated long-press throw signalling over the unchanged packet 244 layout. ID 948, damage, range, cooldown, weather data and terrain remain unchanged. Android rendering, touch behavior, frame time and multiplayer visual acceptance remain pending device verification.
